framework_lessons: Funding structure can dominate asset quality.
assessment: The strongest contributions are the distinction between nominal and real income, unequal fiscal incidence, and the warning about yield-platform liquidity. The preferred recession outlook and immediate Fed-hike-speed forecast failed. ET financial repair and selected pipeline returns were strong, while the broader energy-relative-return sensitivity lagged sharply. The report repeats earlier liquid-staking claims, including an incorrect parity description and incomplete withdrawal timing. Decade inflation and value calls remain open; causal and portfolio claims are not automatically counted as forecast wins.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
